parsed.title: Premium Scenario Unlock
parsed.oneLiner: Watch a quick game to unlock exclusive premium scenarios for 72 hours.

newMechanic.name: Premium Scenario Category
newMechanic.description: Introduces an 'Exclusive Premium' tag for creator scenarios. These are optional, bonus scenarios separate from standard free-to-play content.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Creates a monetizable content anchor that creators can opt into, providing value without degrading existing free interactions.

parsed.trigger: User taps 'Unlock Scenario' on a Premium-tagged character scenario in Character Details.
parsed.eligibility: Non-subscribers only. Applies only to new 'Premium' tagged scenarios; existing free scenarios remain unchanged.

offer.title: Unlock Premium Scenario
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with Willson Wáng to unlock this premium scenario for 72 hours.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Non-subscribers only; gated to new content (no existing free scenarios removed); frequency capped at 3 per day; includes upsell path.
risks: Requires creator adoption to tag scenarios as 'Premium'.
Potential perceived 'gating' if premium tag is misunderstood by the community.
